clue.text: Coppers find that things are much the same

definitions.meaning: copper coins, the low-value pennies jangling in a pocket
read literally, only a slight alteration has happened

explanation.surface: Police officers conclude that nothing much has altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Coppers are loose coins of low value, and a situation barely altered has seen only a minor shift.

clue.text: Fodder for one trapped in a labyrinth

indicators.note: trapped in says one piece is held inside the word for labyrinth

parts.note: a labyrinth is a maze
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone is stuck inside a labyrinth, perhaps feeding livestock.
explanation.definitionFit: Corn is grown as animal feed, so it counts as fodder.

clue.text: Dish that may sink in a little way

indicators.note: in tells us the word for sink sits within the little way

parts.note: a lane is a narrow little road
to sag is to sink down

explanation.surface: A dish that might subside slightly in the oven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sink' looks like the kitchen sink beside a dish; it is the verb, to droop.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian baked pasta with layers of sauce is a classic dish.

clue.text: Nothing can be written in code

definitions.meaning: a zero, the figure 0
a secret system of writing

explanation.surface: Absence can be expressed in secret writing.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the numeral zero and a coded message system.

clue.text: Planned to leave a series of items in the road

indicators.note: in places the series inside the road abbreviation

parts.note: RD is the standard abbreviation for road
a range is a series of products or items

explanation.surface: Someone intends to leave a row of objects lying on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to leave' is just a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: Planned and organised are synonyms; something settled in advance.

clue.text: Undergo ill-treatment, but get compensation

indicators.note: ill-treatment roughs up the word undergo, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Suffer abuse, but receive a payout for it.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for a reward or recompense.

clue.text: Marry-divers do!

definitions.meaning: a colloquial phrase for finally getting wed
divers jump headlong into water

explanation.surface: A wedding announcement for a pair of swimmers.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means committing to wedlock, and literally describes a dive into a pool.

clue.text: Get dressed down for being dressed like a judge

definitions.meaning: to be scolded, in British slang to get a wigging
wearing a wig as British judges do

explanation.surface: Someone is told off for turning up in judicial costume.
explanation.walkthrough: A wigging is British slang for a scolding, so be wigged is to be told off.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearing a periwig in court, or receiving a telling-off, both fit the word.

clue.text: Ending of apartheid means displaced negroes get aid

indicators.note: displaced means the letters are moved out of place and rearranged

explanation.surface: A political comment on the end of segregation in South Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Abolishing racial separation is what dismantling apartheid involved.

clue.text: Wrong a maiden lady

parts.note: an unmarried woman is addressed as Miss

explanation.surface: An unmarried woman made a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Something awry or faulty is wrong.

clue.text: Continue to back salesman of austere nature

indicators.note: to back means the word for salesman is read from the end

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
severe means austere, plain

explanation.surface: A stern seller keeps supporting the cause.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep going despite difficulty is to carry on.

clue.text: Holly, for instance, is constantly jealous

parts.note: ever means always, constantly
green with envy, jealous

explanation.surface: Someone called Holly is perpetually envious.
explanation.definitionFit: Holly keeps its leaves all year, an example of a plant never bare.

clue.text: To tee off requires energy

definitions.meaning: a golfer's long opening shot from the tee
vigour or energy

explanation.surface: Starting a round of golf demands vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: A drive is a golf shot from the tee and also means vigour.

clue.text: He gives the chop to a computer fanatic

definitions.meaning: one who hacks at things with blows
someone obsessed with programming or breaking into systems

explanation.surface: An axe-wielder attacks a computer nerd.
explanation.definitionFit: One who chops roughly, and a programmer obsessed with code, share the word.

clue.text: Delete from the list, despite angry aside

parts.note: cross means angry
off means away, aside

explanation.surface: An irate remark leads to someone being struck from a list.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike out an item by drawing a line through it removes it.

clue.text: A youngster could generate trouble

indicators.note: trouble stirs up the word generate, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Young people may cause problems.
explanation.definitionFit: A person aged thirteen to nineteen is a youngster.

clue.text: To stint on weapons is beneath a member

parts.note: under means beneath
an arm is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: Skimping on armaments is beneath a club member.
explanation.definitionFit: To supply too few arms to a force is to equip it inadequately.

clue.text: Put forward argument against the ecu?

definitions.meaning: to offer an idea for consideration
favouring the British pound over the European currency unit, in the 1990s debate

explanation.surface: Someone makes a case against the European currency.
explanation.walkthrough: The ecu was the proposed European currency; being for the pound meant opposing it.
explanation.definitionFit: To advance a theory is to offer it for discussion; for-the-pound was the anti-ecu stance.

clue.text: Oration made in Canada

indicators.note: made means the letters of oration are made into something new

explanation.surface: A speech delivered in Canada.
explanation.definitionFit: A province of central Canada.

clue.text: Greyhound makes a dear little pet

definitions.meaning: a racing dog runs laps of the track
a small pampered dog kept on the knee

explanation.surface: A large racing dog becomes a cosy companion.
explanation.definitionFit: A pampered small dog sits in its owner's lap; a racing dog runs laps.

clue.text: So US agents in Alabama are not gregarious

indicators.note: in places the other pieces inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: AL is the postal abbreviation for Alabama
taken as written
the CIA is the US intelligence agency

explanation.surface: Spies in Alabama are unsociable.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who avoids company lacks sociability.

clue.text: Stop, but don't let go

definitions.meaning: wait, hang on a moment
keep your grip

explanation.surface: Halt, but keep your grip.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both wait a moment and keep gripping.

clue.text: Reversal for a high-society clique

parts.note: up means high
a set is a social group or clique

explanation.surface: A setback for an upper-class circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A surprise defeat or overturning is a reverse.

clue.text: Changes to incomes demand his attention

definitions.text: Changes to incomes demand his attention

indicators.note: changes means the letters of to and incomes are reordered

explanation.surface: Income adjustments need a specialist to study them.
explanation.definitionFit: A specialist in money and markets studies shifts in earnings.

clue.text: Abraham's son is given a bill

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill

explanation.surface: A biblical patriarch's son receives an invoice.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the son of Abraham and Sarah.

clue.text: Proceed to attack lottery backers

parts.note: to go for someone is to attack them

indicators.note: backers here signals the word for lottery being turned back to front

parts.note: a draw is a lottery

explanation.surface: A call to advance on people who fund the lottery.
explanation.definitionFit: To advance or make progress is to move ahead.

clue.text: One daughter has a house in America

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A girl owns a home in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A state in the north-western United States.

clue.text: Saw Wandsworth, perhaps

definitions.meaning: an old saying, a proverb
Wandsworth Common is a park in south-west London, so a place that is a common

explanation.surface: A tool or a London borough, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: Wandsworth Common is an open green space in south London.
explanation.definitionFit: A trite saying is a platitude; Wandsworth Common is literally a common that is a place.
